declaration: Two-week sprints with a PO-owned backlog. Five developers, GitHub PRs, and nothing ships without QA sign-off. B2B invoicing SaaS on Postgres; customers' ERPs call our public REST API, and they are on SLAs.
answers: The QA lead decides releases. Product discovery happens elsewhere, not in this repository. The workflow should trigger automatically. A separate SRE team owns incidents. Tests run with pnpm test; releases with pnpm release, which also runs migrations. API fields are removed only after 90 days' notice.
